facts.fact: The article states that GAID Article 43, issued by the NDPC in 2025, applies to controllers deploying AI to process personal data and requires assessing disparate outcomes, and that section 37 of the NDPA 2023 bars decisions based solely on automated processing.
The article states the Nigeria Data Protection Commission issued the GAID and applies the NDPA and GAID provisions on automated decisions and AI.
